name: dsh-nuncia
description: Authenticated A2A server bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (fork of MicroWearld/dsh-a2a-server, ported to a no-build ESM library)

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/task-store.js && node --check lib/authority.js && node --check lib/grants.js && node --check lib/inbound.js && node --check lib/outbound.js && node --check lib/notices.js && node --check lib/approvals.js
scripts.test: node --test test-authority.test.mjs test-grants.test.mjs test-inbound.test.mjs test-outbound.test.mjs test-notices.test.mjs test-approvals.test.mjs && node test-smoke.mjs && node test-authority-http.mjs && node test-tools.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test test-authority.test.mjs test-grants.test.mjs test-inbound.test.mjs test-outbound.test.mjs test-notices.test.mjs test-approvals.test.mjs

_note: The DSH host uses the @deepseek-ai/schemastery fork (zod-like), NOT the cordis schemastery this config schema imports — so plain schemastery is a real dependency here, not an ambient symlink (device verified 2026-10-19: plain schemastery is absent from the entire DSH global tree). @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm + @deepseek-ai/dsh-session ARE ambient imports, resolved by symlinks into the CLI's node_modules (sylvia-bridge pattern); they must not be installable peers (npm dist-tags satisfy no sane range).
